purpose: Teach: 久美子/節子/涼子/亜紀/いずみ/千里/かおり/片側

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお友達の久美子さんを夕食に招待されたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad got invited to dinner with his friend Kumiko.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Gentle opening. Straightforward pacing, the tone of sharing news that interests the child. Soft gaze downward.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと節子おばさんの家に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to Aunt Setsuko's house with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet, direct. Small voice carrying genuine delight. No performance — just reporting what happened. A slight lift at the end, seeking acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「涼子さんのお花教室にママを誘って」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said something about inviting me to Ryoko's flower class.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain. Processing aloud as she speaks. Gentle pause before the quote, letting it settle. Reflective but not worried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと亜紀いとこと公園で遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I played in the park with Dad and cousin Aki.
lines.style: Simple, eager. Quick pace. The brightness of a child sharing something that mattered. Voice bright but not loud — the authentic happiness of being included.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「いずみちゃんとも仲良くね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said to be good friends with Izumi too.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly wondering. Speaking more to herself than to him. A soft echo of something that touched her. Measured, reflective pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと千里おばさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Aunt Chisato with Dad.
lines.style: Quick, animated. Genuine excitement breaking through. Higher pitch on the verb. The eagerness of a child who's been somewhere new and is bursting to tell.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「かおりちゃんが結婚されたわ」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad told me that Kaori got married.
lines.style: Warm, slightly nostalgic. Speaking gently, as if remembering something herself. Unhurried pacing. The tone of an adult letting a moment settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「片側通行の道路は気を付けて」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me to be careful on one-way roads.
lines.style: Sincere, attentive. The careful seriousness of a child who's absorbed something important. Slightly slower pace. Soft but definite — he's learned something and wants her to know it matters.
